description: This is one of the easiest, least messy, fastest ways to cook salmon. Once you have it marinated, it's a matter of minutes in the toaster oven or broiler before it's ready to eat.
equipment: plastic zipper lock bag or sealable container

ingredients.prep: at least 1 inch thick, 5 to 6 ounces each
ingredients.raw: 4 skinless salmon fillet, at least 1 inch thick, 5 to 6 ounces each

brief: Whisk miso, sake, soy sauce, oil, and sugar
Transfer to a bag or container and marinate
steps.text: Whisk together {{1/4 cup}} of red or white miso, {{1/3 cup}} of sake, {{1 tbsp}} of soy sauce, {{2 tbsp}} of vegetable oil, and {{1/4 cup}} of sugar. Rub mixture over every surface of salmon fillets. Transfer to a plastic zipper lock bag or sealable container. Proceed immediately to next step, or for best results, marinate for about 30 minutes or up to 2 days.

brief: Cover small broiler pan with foil
Rub excess marinade off salmon and place on pan
Broil until charred and barely warm in center
steps.text: Preheat a broiler (toaster oven or regular oven) to high. Cover a small broiler pan with aluminum foil. Rub excess marinade off of salmon and place on broiler pan. Broil until top surface is well charred and salmon is barely warm in the center, about 5 minutes, using the foil to protect any areas that threaten to burn. Serve immediately.

title: 5-Minute Miso Glazed Salmon Recipe
